title: Missing Airman Raises Concerns That Iran Could Gain Leverage Over the U.S.
partialText: Since 1979, Iran has repeatedly used Americans and Europeans detained on its territory to win concessions over more powerful adversaries.

title: What We Know About the F-15E Strike Eagle Shot Down by Iran
partialText: An F-15E Strike Eagle was shot down over Iran and an A-10 Warthog crashed near the Strait of Hormuz, officials said on Friday. Two airmen were rescued, and one is unaccounted for.

title: Trump Pledged a Quick End to the Iran War, but He Hasn’t Explained How
partialText: President Trump bet that American firepower could cow Iran into compliance. So far, Iran’s leaders have been unwilling to quit.

title: New Attorney General, Same Albatross: Trump’s Quest for Retribution
partialText: The name atop the Justice Department’s organizational chart matters less than the presence of a president whose demands for revenge have become so extreme that even his most obsequious appointees have fallen short.

title: Trump Contemplates Other Cabinet Changes as He Faces Political Clock
partialText: With the midterms approaching, the president may be running out of time to get new cabinet members confirmed without bipartisan support.

title: ‘I Got Back Every Penny’: Inside Trump’s Supercharged Tax Season
partialText: The law Republicans passed last year has so far been largely imperceptible to most Americans. That’s changing as tens of millions file their taxes this spring.

title: Epstein Presented Himself to Indian Tycoon as a Trump White House Insider
partialText: The convicted sex offender gave Anil Ambani information on appointments and foreign policy. Some seemed prescient, though there was no evidence he was close to the administration.

title: Trump Wants to Make Deportation Deals. Autocrats Are Ready to Listen.
partialText: The White House has turned deportations, a signature domestic issue, into a major piece of foreign policy. Here’s what we know about the program.

title: Foreign Doctors Forced Out of U.S. Hospitals by Trump Immigration Policy
partialText: Physicians from 39 countries are being pushed out of U.S. hospitals as a policy blocks their ability to work.

title: ICE Review Finds Dozens of Violations at Texas Migrant Detention Center
partialText: A review of Camp East Montana in Texas found failures in medical care, disease control and oversight, including improperly documented uses of force.

title: Houston Cheers on Artemis II Moon Mission, Reclaiming Its Place as ‘Space City’
partialText: The Artemis II mission elicited deep feelings for many Americans, particularly in Houston, the home of mission control.

title: ‘Hacks’ Has the Last Laugh
partialText: As the HBO comedy finished production earlier this year, a photographer captured some of the final days on set and the showrunners looked back on its award-winning run.

title: Pam and Kristi, Kicked to the Curb
partialText: Trump girls gone wild — or just gone.

title: Trump Needs Smarter Sycophants
partialText: Loyal losers don’t go very far with this president.

title: Living Space
partialText: We don’t have to travel to the moon to gain some of the insight that astronauts do.

title: Are These Crumbling New York City Housing Projects Worth Saving?
partialText: The city thinks four developments in Chelsea are too run-down to be saved, and wants to rebuild them, adding mixed-income housing. Some residents are opposed.

title: Arrest of Wisconsin Mosque Leader Was Tied to Trump Antisemitism Campaign
partialText: Immigration lawyers and former federal officials say the case of Salah Sarsour echoes those against other pro-Palestinian activists.

title: After 11 Years in Court, Heir Reclaims a Modigliani Looted by the Nazis
partialText: A judge ruled against a holding company controlled by David Nahmad, the billionaire art dealer, which had bought the work at auction in 1996.

title: She Wanted Her Hair Done for a Special Day. She Left the Salon in Tears.
partialText: A Black woman is pushing for changes in the hair industry after claiming in a lawsuit that she and her 7-year-old were turned away from an Ulta Beauty salon in Manhattan because of their hair texture.
